concerns.text: FR-002 (US-1) requires excluding records with missing location metadata. T018 only covers the 'Construct Validity Check' (correlation < 0.5). There is no explicit task to implement the metadata exclusion logic described in US-1 Acceptance Scenario 2 and Plan Phase 1 Step 1.2.

FR-005 and US-2 explicitly mandate a 'paired permutation test' comparing the Augmented model against a Null model (predicting zero residuals). T025 describes a standard feature permutation test (shuffling features to generate a null distribution) but lacks the specific logic to implement the 'paired' comparison of R² differences required by the spec.

SC-003 requires measuring computational resource usage (RAM peak, runtime) against GitHub Actions limits. T039 only mentions running 'quickstart.md validation' without a specific task to instrument, log, or verify these metrics during execution.

T026 references 'SC-001, SC-004' but the description focuses on outputting metrics. It does not explicitly tag the 'paired permutation test' logic which is the core of SC-004, creating a traceability gap for the specific hypothesis test requirement.
